title: Disable in-loop filtering only after proving it is a no-op

definition.title: Disable in-loop filtering only after proving it is a no-op
definition.source_excerpt: Mechanism. Prepare a valid H.264 derivative that disables deblocking for an entire admitted picture/slice region only when the original filter provably cannot alter any affected sample. Begin with conservative structural conditions on all luma/chroma edge thresholds and quantizer information; do not infer safety from visual smoothness. Keep coded prediction and residual meaning unchanged while rebuilding affected headers, alignment, escaping, lengths, and offsets. First scope. Progressive eight-bit 4:2:0, CAVLC, one slice per picture, controlled quantizers and offsets, ordinary I/P prediction. First prove all affected thresholds make filtering an identity. Do not generalize one low quantizer value to uninspected blocks or chroma edges.
definition.impact_basis: Useful stage/operation improvement if the target workload and repeated use exist. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Identify the CPU/GPU representation boundary and actual useful work removed. Check existing renderer fusions, caches, kernel fast paths and hardware gates.
definition.minimum_probe: Small deterministic planes/blocks or an existing real frame with one adversarial edge. Use a bounded component test if GPU integration is not already available, labeling it as such.
definition.initial_screen: Identify the CPU/GPU representation boundary and actual useful work removed. Check existing renderer fusions, caches, kernel fast paths and hardware gates. definition.primary_metric: Complete decode/process/present cost, transfers, command work or peak live storage for identical requested output.
definition.scope_contract: Exact integer planes or an explicitly defined numerical/altered-output contract; compare the final requested region and later references where relevant.
definition.negative_control: Change stride, crop, phase, alpha, edge neighborhood or resource generation; exercise a case where the proposed shortcut is ineligible.
definition.stop_boundary: No custom decoder rewrite or GPU platform port. Include staging/readback/cache cost; reject the current implementation rather than the general idea if the executor is a proxy.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Actual required API/format for any GPU claim; CPU algebra is a separate component observation, not browser qualification.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.

record.reason: Pinned FFmpeg already returns when alpha/beta are zero and the historical encoder already disabled these filters. Its successful rewrite needed an artificially enabled equivalent source. A new derivative preprocessor has no demonstrated useful no-op workload in current software decode.
